spec.name: Moulay Ali Belarabi mosque
spec.description: A 16th-century mosque in Ksar El Kebir distinguished by its uniquely rare hexagonal minaret. It was a major center of learning where the prominent scholar Ibn Al-Arabi taught, and it now serves as his final resting place.

timeline.title: Construction
timeline.description: Built during the Saadian dynasty, becoming a vibrant center of learning.

timeline.title: Death of Ibn Al-Arabi
timeline.description: The scholar Abu Al-Hasan Ali Ibn Al-Arabi was entombed within the mosque.

timeline.title: Modern Renovation
timeline.description: Closed for extensive renovation, scheduled for completion in mid-2026.

comments: The popular city saint Abu El Mahassin Yussuf El Fassi studied and later taught in the mosque.
